title: MLB Playoffs: Brewers vs. Padres Series Spread
description:
The 2026 MLB Playoffs National League Division Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and San Diego Padres is a best-of-five series, won by the first team to win three games. Each market in this event names a team and a series spread of -1.5 or -2.5 games, and its two outcomes are the named team with that spread (for example, "Brewers -1.5") and the other team with the opposite spread (for example, "Padres +1.5"). A -1.5 spread is covered if the named team wins the series 3-0 or 3-1, and a -2.5 spread is covered if the named team wins the series 3-0. If the series is completed, each market will resolve to the named team's outcome if its spread is covered and to the other team's outcome if it is not.

If the series is not completed by October 23, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, for any reason, including cancellation of the 2026 MLB Playoffs, a market will resolve to the other team's outcome if the other team has already won enough games that the named team can no longer cover the spread (2 games against a -1.5 spread, 1 game against a -2.5 spread). Otherwise, it will resolve to 50-50. Only games completed by that time will be counted.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from MLB; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
